informal_statement: The Euclidean image of the full cap parameter interval has the cap's stated arc length.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:457-483, the source contract is `theorem exact_euclidean_capParam_hausdorffMeasure (c : OneSidedCircularCap) : (μH[1] : Measure EuclideanPlane) (realizedCapParam c '' Icc (capStart c) (capEnd c)) = ENNReal.ofReal c.arcLength`. The length measure is Euclidean one-dimensional Hausdorff measure on the complete frontier. Arc/segment unions are combined using their proved null overlaps; glued internal chords are not charged as exterior boundary.
